body:
Self-contained specification for headless agy print-mode hardening, RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION 1.5.9, and the 14-row / 1,440-state classifyAgyOutcome() classifier.

IMPORTANT HEADLESS WORKER SHELL RULE: In this headless worker session (`bwrap`), `PreToolUse` allows ONLY targeted `node --test <your-ticket-test-files>` (plus pure read commands `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `grep`, `ls`, `wc`, `git status`, `git diff`). Run ONLY the targeted `node --test` command listed at the bottom of this ticket — do NOT run `npm test`, `test/security.test.mjs`, `test/unit.test.mjs` (which spawn nested `bwrap` containers that fail inside outer `bwrap`), `npm run build`, `node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs`, `node -e`, or edit `dist/**` / `website/generated/**`, and NEVER emit `TICKET-BLOCKED` when your targeted `node --test` command passes (the scheduler runs the full `npm test` gate outside nested `bwrap` automatically after your turn).

1. `lib/doctor.mjs` & `test/doctor.test.mjs`:
   - Keep `export const MIN_AGY_VERSION = '1.2.6';` and add `export const RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION = '1.5.9';`.
   - In `checkAgyBinary`: attach `version: versionStr` on returned objects once `versionStr` is parsed. When `semverGte(versionStr, MIN_AGY_VERSION)` and `semverLt(versionStr, RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION)`, return `{ name: 'agy CLI', level: 'warn', version: versionStr, detail: `${v} (recommended >= v${RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION}; Orchestrator slugs auto-disabled)`, fix: `Upgrade agy to >= ${RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION} for Orchestrator (Carbon/Argon) support.` }`; when `>= RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION`, return `{ name: 'agy CLI', level: 'pass', version: versionStr, detail: v, fix: null }`. Update `test/doctor.test.mjs` for `1.2.6 <= v < 1.5.9` (`warn`) vs `>= 1.5.9` (`pass`) and `< 1.2.6` (`fail`).
   - Export `checkHookLogDir({ env = process.env, home = env.HOME || homedir() } = {})` inspecting `markerPath = join(home, '.gemini', 'antigravity-cli', '.agb-hook-log-degraded')`, `logDir = join(home, '.gemini', 'antigravity-cli', 'plugin_data', 'antigravity-booster', 'logs')`, and `logFile = join(logDir, 'hooks.log')`: if `existsSync(markerPath)` or `(lstatOrNull(logDir)?.isSymbolicLink())` or `(lstatOrNull(logFile)?.isSymbolicLink())`, return `{ name: 'Hook audit log', level: 'warn', detail: 'audit log degraded or symlinked', fix: `Inspect ${logDir} permissions/symlinks and remove ${markerPath}.` }`; otherwise return `{ name: 'Hook audit log', level: 'pass', detail: 'healthy', fix: null }`. Wire `checkHookLogDir` into `runDoctor`.

2. `lib/brain.mjs`, `lib/plan.mjs`, `lib/preflight.mjs`, `lib/prosecute.mjs`, `lib/review.mjs`, `bin/agb.mjs`:
   - Add optional `disableOrchestrator: { type: 'boolean' }` to `BRAIN_PLAN_SCHEMA.properties` in `lib/brain.mjs`, and validate in `validatePlan()` (`lib/plan.mjs`) that if `plan.disableOrchestrator !== undefined`, `typeof plan.disableOrchestrator === 'boolean'`.
   - Ensure all `9/9` `runAgy()` callsites set worker env: `lib/scheduler.mjs` (`worker: { ticket }`), and `worker: { mode: 'readonly' }` on every `runAgy()` call in `lib/plan.mjs`, `lib/preflight.mjs`, `lib/brain.mjs`, `lib/prosecute.mjs`, `lib/review.mjs`, and `bin/agb.mjs` (`probe` subcommand).

3. `lib/agy.mjs` & `test/fixtures/fake-agy`:
   - Preserve the existing `innerBwrapArgs` / `innerSeatbeltArgs` `--sandbox` filter already in `lib/agy.mjs`!
   - In `runAgy()`, append `'--disable-slash-commands'` after `--model <slug>` whenever `options.disableSlashCommands !== false`.
   - Update `test/fixtures/fake-agy` to accept `--disable-slash-commands` and exit `2` on unknown `--*` flags during print/input-format invocations. Keep `test/agy.test.mjs` green.
   - Export `FAILURE_FINISHED_REASONS = new Set(['error', 'failed', 'aborted', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'max_tokens', 'length', 'safety', 'recitation'])` and exact frozen 17-item array `ALL_AGY_ERROR_KINDS = Object.freeze(['containment_unavailable', 'stream_overflow', 'stream_corruption', 'timeout', 'spawn', 'signal', 'interrupted', 'model_unavailable', 'envelope_error', 'server', 'server_shutdown_error', 'cli', 'missing_terminal_result', 'missing_structured_output', 'schema_violation', 'empty', 'unclassified'])`.
   - Implement and export pure helper `classifyAgyOutcome({ outputFormat, killReason = null, spawnError = null, code, signal = null, terminalResult = null, envelope = null, jsonValid = true, schemaErrorKind = null, schemaErrorMsg = null, finishedReason, out = '', err = '', lastErrLine, legacyPre150 = false, requestedModel = null })` (reusing `isAgyTimeout(out)` at `lib/agy.mjs:116`):
     - Helpers:
       - `errLines`: when `typeof code === 'number' && code !== 0`, if `lastErrLine !== undefined` use `[String(lastErrLine).trim()].filter(Boolean)`, else take up to the last `16` non-empty `\r?\n`-trimmed lines of `err` in reverse order; else `[]`.
       - `lastAgyErr`: first line in `errLines` matching `/^AGY_ERROR:\s*(\{[^\r\n]{1,4096}\})$/` that parses via `JSON.parse` to a plain non-array object, else `null`.
       - `effFinishedReason = finishedReason ?? terminalResult?.finished_reason ?? envelope?.finished_reason`.
       - `isPrintTimeout`: `effFinishedReason === 'print_timeout'` OR (`!terminalResult && !envelope && code === 3 && errLines.some((l) => /^\[agy\] print timeout after \d+/.test(l))`) OR (`outputFormat === 'text' && legacyPre150 && isAgyTimeout(out)`).
       - `isModelUnavailable`: `lastAgyErr?.code === 404 || lastAgyErr?.httpStatus === 404 || lastAgyErr?.status === 'NOT_FOUND'` OR (message `m = lastAgyErr?.message ?? terminalResult?.error ?? envelope?.error` is a string matching `/^unknown model\b|model\s+['"]?[a-z0-9._-]+['"]?\s+not (?:found|available)/i` without `.json` file paths, and if `requestedModel` is set, `m.toLowerCase().includes(requestedModel.toLowerCase()) || /^unknown model\b/i.test(m)`).
       - `detectRateLimit`: if `lastAgyErr` has structured `code`/`httpStatus`/`status`, `true` iff `lastAgyErr.code === 429 || lastAgyErr.httpStatus === 429 || lastAgyErr.status === 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED'`, else regex `/\b429\b|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|rate[ _-]?limit(?:ed)?|quota exceeded/i` against `terminalResult?.error ?? envelope?.error ?? (code !== 0 ? errLines.join('\n') : '')`.
     - Exact 14-Row Sequential `if / else if` Branches:
       1. `killReason != null` -> `{ ok: false, kind: killReason.kind, rateLimited: false, error: killReason.error }`
       2. `spawnError != null || (code === null && signal === null)` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'spawn', rateLimited: false, error: spawnError ? `spawn: ${spawnError.message}` : 'spawn: failed to start' }`
       3. `code === null` (`signal !== null`) -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'signal', rateLimited: false, error: `killed by signal ${signal}` }`
       4. `isPrintTimeout` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'timeout', rateLimited: false, error: 'print-timeout' }`
       5. `effFinishedReason === 'interrupted'` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'interrupted', rateLimited: false, error: 'interrupted' }`
       6. `FAILURE_FINISHED_REASONS.has(String(effFinishedReason ?? '').toLowerCase()) || (outputFormat === 'stream-json' && terminalResult != null && (terminalResult.status !== 'SUCCESS' || (terminalResult.exit_code !== 0 && terminalResult.exit_code !== undefined && terminalResult.exit_code !== null))) || (outputFormat === 'json' && envelope != null && ['error', 'failed'].includes(String(envelope.status ?? '').toLowerCase()))` -> `{ ok: false, kind: isModelUnavailable ? 'model_unavailable' : (outputFormat === 'json' ? 'envelope_error' : 'server'), rateLimited: detectRateLimit(), error: outputFormat === 'json' && envelope != null ? `agy returned error status in JSON envelope: ${envelope.status}${envelope.error || envelope.response ? ` (${envelope.error || envelope.response})` : ''}` : (terminalResult ? `terminal result status ${terminalResult.status}: exit_code ${terminalResult.exit_code}` : `finished_reason ${effFinishedReason}`) }`
       7. `outputFormat === 'stream-json' && terminalResult != null && code !== 0` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'server_shutdown_error', rateLimited: false, error: `process exited with code ${code} despite terminal result SUCCESS` }`
       8. `outputFormat === 'stream-json' && terminalResult == null && code !== 0` -> `{ ok: false, kind: lastAgyErr ? (isModelUnavailable ? 'model_unavailable' : 'server') : 'cli', rateLimited: detectRateLimit(), error: `exit ${code}: ${(err || out).slice(-300)}` }`
       9. `outputFormat === 'stream-json' && terminalResult == null` (`code === 0`) -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'missing_terminal_result', rateLimited: false, error: 'process exited with 0 without emitting terminal result' }`
       10. `outputFormat !== 'stream-json' && code !== 0` -> `{ ok: false, kind: isModelUnavailable ? 'model_unavailable' : 'server', rateLimited: detectRateLimit(), error: `exit ${code}: ${(err || out).slice(-300)}` }`
       11. `outputFormat === 'json' && (!jsonValid || schemaErrorKind != null)` -> `{ ok: false, kind: schemaErrorKind ?? 'schema_violation', rateLimited: false, error: schemaErrorMsg ?? 'Invalid JSON structured output' }`
       12. `outputFormat === 'text' && out.trim().length === 0` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'empty', rateLimited: false, error: 'exit 0: empty output' }`
       13. `outputFormat === 'stream-json' || outputFormat === 'json' || outputFormat === 'text'` -> `{ ok: true, kind: null, rateLimited: false, error: null }`
       14. `else` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'unclassified', rateLimited: false, error: `unclassified agy outcome for outputFormat=${String(outputFormat)}` }`.
     - Wire `classifyAgyOutcome(...)` inside `runAgy()` and include `rateLimited: Boolean(classified.rateLimited)` on the resolved `runAgy()` result.

4. Atomic `lib/scheduler.mjs` Handling:
   - Handle every `kind` in `ALL_AGY_ERROR_KINDS`:
     - `'signal'`, `'timeout'`, `'interrupted'`, `'spawn'`: `strikes += 1`, `safeResetToBase()`, skip `recordStrikeSession()`, do NOT increment `fleetCliFailures`.
     - `'model_unavailable'`: add `model` to run-scoped `disabledModels` `Set`, clear `lastConversationId = null` and `lastStrikeModel = null`, reroute via `tierCandidates` with `0` strikes consumed (if zero candidates remain, `strikes += 1` and fail cleanly).
     - `build.rateLimited === true`: call `await pools.refreshQuota(process.env.AGB_AGY_BIN || resolveAgyBinary() || 'agy')`; when `strikes < 2` (at most 1 free rate-limit reroute per strike) and an alternate candidate in another non-depleted pool exists, clear `lastConversationId = null` and `lastStrikeModel = null` and reroute cross-pool without incrementing `strikes`.

5. Tests (`test/agy-1-5-9-print.test.mjs`):
   - Test all 14 canonical golden vectors + `'completed'` benign `finished_reason` -> `ok: true`, `'max_tokens'` -> `ok: false, kind: 'server'`, `'cannot open model.json: file not found'` -> NOT `'model_unavailable'`, trailing Go shutdown line after `AGY_ERROR: {"code":429,"status":"RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}` -> `rateLimited: true`, and `< 1.5.0` vs `>= 1.5.0` `text` timeout.
   - Test the exact `1,440`-state cross-product (`3 * 2 * 4 * 5 * 4 * 3 = 1,440` states), asserting `ok === (kind === null)`, every non-null `kind` in `ALL_AGY_ERROR_KINDS`, and Rows `1..13` each hit `>= 1` time.
   - Add scheduler integration tests using `fake-agy` verifying `'signal'` does not bump `fleetCliFailures`, `'model_unavailable'` demotes without burning a strike, and `rateLimited` cross-pool reroute clears `lastConversationId`/`lastStrikeModel`.
   - Verify with `node --test test/agy-1-5-9-print.test.mjs test/agy.test.mjs test/doctor.test.mjs` and finish cleanly.

edges.contract: T4 exports RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION = '1.5.9', MIN_AGY_VERSION = '1.2.6', checkAgyBinary() (including version field), and checkHookLogDir() from lib/doctor.mjs; exports FAILURE_FINISHED_REASONS, ALL_AGY_ERROR_KINDS, and classifyAgyOutcome() from lib/agy.mjs; supports optional boolean plan.disableOrchestrator in lib/brain.mjs + lib/plan.mjs; and wires signal/timeout/interrupted/model_unavailable/rateLimited handling in lib/scheduler.mjs.

title: Add --disable-slash-commands, RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION 1.5.9, and 1,440-state classifyAgyOutcome()
